A '''big-mouthed creature''' lived in the swamps of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. It was amphibian-like in appearance; it had stubby legs and feet and a long tail with four protuberances at the end of it.<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

== Behind the scenes ==
This creature appeared in [[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide|''The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide'']]'','' written by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] and [[Bob Carrau]] and illustrated by Terryl Whitlatch, at the beginning of the Dagobah section of the book. It isn't named in the book, nor is there an entry about it.<ref name="Wildlife" />
